description_en: Queries the SSL configuration of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的SSL配置情况
name: DescribeDBInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

ACL.description_en:
The authentication method for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported by ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL 12 and later)
ACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

CAType.description_en:
The type of the server certificate for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
aliyun: cloud certificate.
custom: custom certificate
CAType.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书类型，返回值：
aliyun：使用云证书
custom：使用自定义证书

ClientCACert.description_en: The public key of the client certificate authority (CA) for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ClientCACert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥

ClientCACertExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the public key of the client certificate authority (CA) for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

This parameter is not supported. You can ignore this parameter
ClientCACertExpireTime.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥有效期。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

暂不支持该参数，无需关注

ClientCertRevocationList.description_en: The client certificate revocation list file for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ClientCertRevocationList.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端吊销证书文件

ForceEncryption.description_en:
Indicates whether the [forced SSL encryption]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html） feature is enabled for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values:

1: enabled.
0: disabled
ForceEncryption.description_zh:
SQL Server实例的[强制SSL加密功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html）是否已开启，返回值：

1：开启。
0：未开启

LastModifyStatus.description_en:
The current SSL configuration status for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:

success: successful.
setting: configuring.
failed: failed
LastModifyStatus.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态，返回值：

success：成功
setting：设置中
failed：失败

ModifyStatusReason.description_en: The reason for the current SSL configuration status of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ModifyStatusReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例当前SSL链路配置状态对应的原因

ReplicationACL.description_en:
The authentication method for the replication permission of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported by ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL 12 and later)
ReplicationACL.description_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的replication权限认证方法，返回值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

RequireUpdate.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate needs to be updated. Valid values:

The validity period of an SSL certificate is one year. If you do not update the certificate after it expires, client programs that use encrypted connections cannot connect to the instance.
<details>
<summary>MySQL and SQL Server</summary>

No: The certificate does not need to be updated.
Yes: The certificate needs to be updated.
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

0: The certificate does not need to be updated.
1: The certificate needs to be updated.

</details>
RequireUpdate.description_zh:
是否需要更新SSL证书，返回值：

SSL证书有效期为1年，证书到期后不更新，会导致使用加密连接的客户端程序无法正常连接实例。
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

No：无需更新
Yes：需更新
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

0：无需更新
1：需更新

</details>

RequireUpdateItem.description_en: The list of server certificates that need to be updated for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
RequireUpdateItem.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新的服务器证书列表

RequireUpdateReason.description_en: The reason why the certificate needs to be updated for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
RequireUpdateReason.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例需要更新证书的原因

SSLCreateTime.description_en: The time when the server certificate was created for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. This parameter is valid only when CAType is set to aliyun
SSLCreateTime.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书创建时间，当CAType配置为aliyun时有效

SSLEnabled.description_en:
The SSL encryption status. Valid values:
<details>
<summary>MySQL and SQL Server</summary>

Yes: enabled.
No: disabled.
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

on: enabled.
off: disabled.

</details>
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
SSL的加密状态，返回值：
<details>
<summary>MySQL、SQL Server</summary>

Yes：已开启
No：未开启
</details>

<details>
<summary>PostgreSQL</summary>

on：已开启
off：未开启

</details>

SSLExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the SSL certificate. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

ServerCAUrl.description_en: The URL of the CA certificate that issued the server certificate for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerCAUrl.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例签发服务器证书的CA证书URL

ServerCert.description_en: The content of the server certificate for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerCert.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书内容

ServerKey.description_en: The private key of the server certificate for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks
ServerKey.description_zh: PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书私钥

TlsVersion.description_en: The specified [minimum TLS version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html） for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2
TlsVersion.description_zh: SQL Server实例已指定的[最低LTS版本号]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html），当前支持1.0、1.1、1.2
